conditions: Real angles a and b in consistent units.
spoken_aliases: cosine of open parenthesis a plus b close parenthesis equals cosine of a times cosine of b minus sine of a times sine of b
cosine of the sum of a and b equals the product of cosine of a and cosine of b minus the product of sine of a and sine of b

evidence: Compose planar rotations of angles a and b. The top-left entry of the product of their rotation matrices is cos(a)cos(b)-sin(a)sin(b); the product is rotation through a+b, whose top-left entry is cos(a+b).

Reference cross-check of the standard relationship: https://openstax.org/books/precalculus-2e/pages/7-2-sum-and-difference-identities. Checked 2026-11-27. Proposed maintainer approval; not independent human certification.
